rv.q: I found myself longing for him (the director) to edit all these bright ideas down into something zippier and more coherent.

Malvolio’s costume changes, for example, show the dramatic contrast before and after he is deceived into believing that Olivia loves him. The expressive facial makeup also serves the work both practically and aesthetically.
This is a heartening evening out, where the atmosphere is almost pantomime-like and the complicity between players and audience becomes total.
Sadly, most of it falls very flat.
Full of passion, poetry, and playfulness, this year’s Dream in High Park is, in a word, perfection.
With all this, Creation Theatre’s Twelfth Night is not one to miss.
It’s an extremely fun production and I had a lovely day out followed by theatre.
For a night of laughs under the stars after a day exploring a London landmark, there are few better options than Theatre on Kew ’s Twelfth Night.
Overall, it was a thoroughly enjoyable evening.

cn.t: Critics largely embrace this outdoor production for its warmth and humor, praising memorable comic moments and audience engagement. One dissenting voice finds it disappointing after a strong start.
